ctrl.claim: Two plus/X cursors on board; SPACE toggles active (white center pixel); arrows move active cursor by 3 cells/step.

goal.claim: Win when each colored cursor arms cover all dots of its matching color (dots hidden while covered). Lvl1 done this way.

goal2.claim: Win: every dot covered by an arm of a cursor of the SAME color as the dot (lvl4 needed swatch recolor first).

lvl6.claim: Lvl6: blocker = gray 8x8 square rows28-35 cols28-35 (diamond hole). Cursor arms SLIDE through intersection when blocked: plus left arm folded to right (bar 25px conserved, vertical bar slid to bar end).

shapes.claim: Cursor shapes: plus(row+col arm13), X(2 diagonals arm~10-11), diamond(Manhattan circle r~9-12), bar(row line arm21). Arm lengths vary per level - measure.

swatch.claim: Colored 5x5 swatch pads: placing a cursor CENTER on a swatch permanently recolors that cursor to the swatch color (lvl4).
